num__coop_score.label: Cooperative / SHG standing
num__coop_score.meaning: Repayment and participation record inside the applicant's self-help group or cooperative society.
num__coop_score.high: A strong community standing is one of the best available substitutes for a formal repayment record.
num__coop_score.low: Weak or absent cooperative standing leaves the file with little peer-verified repayment evidence.

num__psychometric_score.label: Psychometric assessment
num__psychometric_score.meaning: Timed behavioural test measuring planning horizon, risk appetite and consistency of responses.
num__psychometric_score.high: Consistent, forward-planning answers correlate with disciplined repayment behaviour.
num__psychometric_score.low: Impulsive or inconsistent responses are associated with higher delinquency in thin-file cohorts.

num__bill_on_time_ratio.label: Utility bill punctuality
num__bill_on_time_ratio.meaning: Share of electricity, water and gas bills settled on or before the due date over the last six months.
num__bill_on_time_ratio.high: Paying recurring bills on time demonstrates the same discipline an EMI schedule requires.
num__bill_on_time_ratio.low: Frequently late utility payments signal cash-flow strain before any loan is added.

num__income_signal.label: Inferred income stability
num__income_signal.meaning: Composite of payment sizes and regularity used as a proxy for earnings consistency.
num__income_signal.high: Stable inferred earnings support a predictable repayment capacity.
num__income_signal.low: Volatile inferred earnings make a fixed instalment harder to service.

num__sms_count.label: Transactional SMS activity
num__sms_count.meaning: Monthly volume of transactional messages, a proxy for how much formal financial activity the applicant generates.
num__sms_count.high: Higher transactional volume gives the model more verifiable financial footprint to work with.
num__sms_count.low: Sparse activity leaves a thin footprint and widens the uncertainty around the score.

num__sim_tenure.label: SIM tenure
num__sim_tenure.meaning: Months the applicant has held the same mobile number.
num__sim_tenure.high: A long-held number is a durable identity anchor and correlates with settled circumstances.
num__sim_tenure.low: A recently activated number offers little history to verify identity or stability against.

num__recharge_freq.label: Recharge regularity
num__recharge_freq.meaning: How reliably prepaid recharges happen before the pack lapses.
num__recharge_freq.high: Recharging before expiry, month after month, is a small but genuine repayment-like commitment.
num__recharge_freq.low: Letting packs lapse repeatedly suggests short-term liquidity gaps.

num__location_stability.label: Location stability
num__location_stability.meaning: Consistency of the applicant's primary location over the past twelve months.
num__location_stability.high: A stable location lowers collection risk and supports field verification.
num__location_stability.low: Frequent relocation raises both traceability and collection risk.

num__land_verified.label: Land record verification
num__land_verified.meaning: Whether an agricultural or residential land holding was matched against state land records.
num__land_verified.high: A verified holding provides a tangible anchor behind an otherwise unsecured file.
num__land_verified.low: Without a verified holding the exposure rests entirely on behavioural signals.

num__loan_amount_requested.label: Requested principal
num__loan_amount_requested.meaning: The amount the applicant asked for, relative to their inferred capacity.
num__loan_amount_requested.high: A large ask relative to inferred capacity raises the instalment burden and therefore the risk.
num__loan_amount_requested.low: A modest ask is comfortably serviceable on the inferred capacity.

num__loan_amount_log.label: Requested principal (log scale)
num__loan_amount_log.meaning: Log-transformed principal, which is how the model reads loan size.
num__loan_amount_log.high: A larger principal raises the instalment burden relative to inferred capacity.
num__loan_amount_log.low: A smaller principal keeps the instalment well within inferred capacity.

cat__region_rural.label: Rural region
cat__region_rural.high: Rural files lean more heavily on cooperative standing and land verification than on telecom signals.
cat__region_rural.low: Urban files carry a denser digital footprint for the model to read.

cat__user_type_feature_phone.label: Feature-phone user
cat__user_type_feature_phone.meaning: The applicant's handset is a feature phone rather than a smartphone.
cat__user_type_feature_phone.high: A feature phone generates fewer digital signals, so the score rests on a narrower base.
cat__user_type_feature_phone.low: Smartphone usage yields a richer behavioural footprint.

cat__recharge_pattern_often_late.label: Frequently late recharges
cat__recharge_pattern_often_late.meaning: Recharges routinely happen after the previous pack has expired.
cat__recharge_pattern_often_late.high: A persistent pattern of late recharges is among the stronger negative behavioural markers.
cat__recharge_pattern_often_late.low: Timely recharges indicate steady small-ticket cash availability.
